freeze_policy.dev: dev split may be inspected and used for harness development
freeze_policy.challenge: newly seeded holdout; run once only after code/prompt freeze and never tune on individual failures
freeze_policy.on_failure: record the report; only regression suites may be tuned, then create another newly seeded holdout

known_evaluation_gaps: repository-visible sealed data is a reproducible holdout, not a secret benchmark
synthetic catalog/query distributions do not replace anonymised production traffic
